notices.title: NOTICES
lines: [w]A text service for the SIGNAL network,
[w]carried in the gaps of the picture.
[c]Every page is sent round in a loop.
[c]Key a number and the set waits for
[c]that page to come past. The number
[c]in the top line counts while it does.
